lane:
لزورد

لازورد لَازَوَردٌ [and لَازُوَرْدٌ], an arabicized word, [from the Persian لَاCْورْدْ,] _A well-known stone;_ [_lapis lazuli;_] _used as a material with which to write, and as a medicine._ (MF.)

لا_زوردى لَا زَُوَرْدِىٌّ _Of the colour of lapis lazuli._]
